patch_description:
The previous SEARCH block did not match the actual file contents. Based on the reported editable region, the file ends with a simple random point generator inside a function. This edit replaces the random-uniform generation with a full deterministic Heilbronn n=13 optimizer, keeping the same function signature and return type (an (n, 2) NumPy array of points whose convex hull is normalized to unit area).

The implementation:
1. Optimizes points freely in the plane (scale-invariant objective) and rescales so the convex hull has exactly unit area — the hull itself is the unit-area convex region, so all points are guaranteed inside/on it.
2. Uses multiple structured seeds (3-fold symmetric concentric triangle shells + center point, regular 13-gon, hexagonal core, plus fixed-seed jittered variants).
3. Refines each seed with a targeted stochastic hill-climb: perturbs one vertex of one of the 5 smallest-area triangles, accepts only strict improvements of min-triangle-area / hull-area, with adaptive step size (coarse-to-fine).
4. Enforces determinism via fixed seeds (42 preserved for compatibility, plus fixed internal seeds) and a wall-clock deadline for efficiency.
5. Includes a guarded symmetric fallback configuration and validation (13 finite, unique points) for robustness.
